articles.title: How Qualcomm’s Mixed Jury Verdict With Arm Could Inform the Long-Term Thesis for QCOM Investors
articles.description: • Earlier this month, a federal jury in Delaware delivered a mixed verdict in Qualcomm’s case against Arm, finding that Arm breached Qualcomm’s Architectural License Agreement and interfered with its business relationship with Meta Platforms, while awarding Qualcomm US$2 in nominal damages. Arm said the jury found for it on four other claims.

articles.title: AI chiefs sound alarm on security risks
articles.description: Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis cautioned that recent AI-driven cyberattacks were “early warning shots”, as more serious incidents could emerge over time unless companies and governments stepped up efforts to secure AI systems. The post AI chiefs sound alarm on security risks appeared first on Mobile World Live.
